structures.label: Sternocleidomastoid
structures.description: Prominent diagonal muscle from the sternum and clavicle to behind the ear.
structures.function: Turns the head to the opposite side and bends the neck forwards.

structures.label: Trapezius, upper fibers
structures.description: Upper part of the trapezius covering the back of the neck.
structures.function: Lifts the shoulders and extends the head; often tight with stress.

structures.label: Splenius capitis & cervicis
structures.description: Bandage-like muscles under the trapezius at the back of the neck.
structures.function: Extend and rotate the head and neck.

structures.label: Levator scapulae
structures.description: Muscle from the upper neck vertebrae to the top of the shoulder blade.
structures.function: Lifts the shoulder blade and tilts the neck; a classic "stiff neck" muscle.

structures.label: Scalenes
structures.description: Three muscles on the side of the neck attaching to the first two ribs.
structures.function: Bend the neck sideways and lift the ribs in deep breathing.

structures.label: Deep neck extensors
structures.description: Layered muscles running along the back of the cervical spine.
structures.function: Hold the head upright and control each vertebra.

structures.label: Deep neck flexors
structures.description: Muscles on the front of the cervical spine, behind the throat.
structures.function: Tuck the chin and stabilise the neck; weak in "forward head" posture.

structures.label: Nuchal ligament
structures.description: Fibrous sheet in the midline of the back of the neck.
structures.function: Anchors neck muscles and limits forward bending.

structures.label: Cervical discs
structures.description: Cartilage cushions between the neck vertebrae.
structures.function: Absorb load and allow movement; C5-C6 and C6-C7 herniate most.

structures.label: Atlas (C1) & axis (C2)
structures.description: First two vertebrae, specialised to carry and rotate the skull.
structures.function: About half of neck rotation happens between C1 and C2.

structures.label: Cervical vertebrae C3–C7
structures.function: Support the head and allow flexion, extension and side bending.

structures.label: Occipital bone
structures.description: Back of the skull, resting on the atlas.

structures.label: Hyoid bone
structures.description: U-shaped bone in the front of the neck that touches no other bone.
structures.function: Anchor for the tongue and swallowing muscles.
